verification.method: unittest offline; eval with paid API calls on demand

test.title: CheckFactsTest
test.checks: identical text clean; swapped amounts between names; lost/added numbers; units and number words normalised; HH:00 equals hour; unit change; inverted negation; moved negation not flagged; lost name; name in another case kept; utm tail is not a lost link; lost link; dates incl. ranges; hedge loss is a check; modality/scope/condition/attribution words that got rarer and intensifiers that got more frequent are checks; polite Вы/Ваш is not a name; a date does not span a line break; lost structural HTML tags are errors, lost emphasis tags are checks; CLI exit codes 0/1/2

test.title: CleanPasteTest
test.checks: contentReference; source tokens and cite; utm tail removed with link and punctuation kept; invisible chars; emoji ZWJ and NBSP kept; clean text untouched

test.title: RepoTest
test.checks: real tree clean; version mismatch, missing reference, CRLF and invisible chars caught

test.title: test_zip_layout
test.checks: humanizer-ru/SKILL.md at the root, ASCII names, no caches

test.title: blind comparison
test.checks: ranking against competitors and the one-line prompt; fact errors by judge majority and check_facts; traps

test.title: EvalReportTest
test.checks: one vote per judge: two passes of one judge do not outvote another judge; strict majority of 2 or 3 judges; one-judge runs keep the pass rule; equal-weight means

test.title: reports of dev and final runs
test.checks: aggregation checked by hand against judgments.jsonl on dev1

gaps.gap: Only the vote rules of report.py have unit tests; the scripts that call paid APIs are checked by hand on dev runs.
check_facts.py does not see lost conditions in words ("при включённой двухфакторной аутентификации"); the skill tells the agent to reread conditions.
The comparison emulates a skill run through the API with a read_file tool; installed runs in Claude Code and DSH are checked by hand on a few texts.
